constraints.constraint: tasklets * sum of operand tiles <= mram (assuming no sharing)
tasklets * sum of operand tiles <= wram (assuming no sharing)
input 0's mram tile must be a whole number of 8-byte DMA granules, i.e. a multiple of 2 elements
input 1's mram tile must be a whole number of 8-byte DMA granules, i.e. a multiple of 2 elements
output 0's mram tile must be a whole number of 8-byte DMA granules, i.e. a multiple of 2 elements
gemv.order: item 0 takes one of the first (number active) places when it is active
gemv.order: item 0 takes a place past the active ones when it is inactive
gemv.order: items 0 and 1 keep index order while both are inactive (symmetry)
gemv.order: item 1 takes one of the first (number active) places when it is active
gemv.order: item 1 takes a place past the active ones when it is inactive

params.name: dpus
params.doc: number of DPUs the workgroup spans (ATiM: product of blockIdx extents)

params.name: gemv.M.mram
params.doc: mram tile size of iteration dim M (extent 1024) of cinm.op.gemv; per LEAF -- across all dims, prod(extent/tile) == dpus*tasklets, so one such tile per (dpu, tasklet) worker, not per DPU; must divide the extent

params.name: gemv.M.wram
params.doc: wram tile size of iteration dim M (extent 1024) of cinm.op.gemv; must divide the previous level's tile

params.name: gemv.K.mram
params.doc: mram tile size of iteration dim K (extent 1024) of cinm.op.gemv; per LEAF -- across all dims, prod(extent/tile) == dpus*tasklets, so one such tile per (dpu, tasklet) worker, not per DPU; must divide the extent

params.name: gemv.K.wram
params.doc: wram tile size of iteration dim K (extent 1024) of cinm.op.gemv; must divide the previous level's tile

params.name: gemv.order
params.doc: which iteration dim occupies which workgroup axis (cnm.workgroup_dim_order). An item is active only when its dim is actually distributed (extent / mram tile > 1); see the encoding note
params.encoding: dimension k holds the 1-based place of item k; place 1 is the outermost workgroup axis (slowest-varying across leaves, cnm.workgroup_dim_order position 0). Items declared conditionally active take the low places when active; inactive items are forced to the remaining high places in item-index order.
